title: Repayment posting reduces outstanding principal and recalculates the delinquency bucket

scope_out: must not update or delete an existing repayment_posting row; must not charge a late fee, penal interest or open a collections workflow; must not re-derive bucket boundaries locally instead of calling the published ladder

entities.name: Repayment posting reduces outstanding principal and recalculates the delinquency bucket

files: (owned by E9-S3) to derive the oldest unpaid Installment and cumulative due/paid; allocates FIFO across whole Installments and, within the oldest unpaid Installment, applies interest before principal per D-K, so
operations.text:
1. Define `post_repayment(loan_id, amount: Money, actor) -> Repayment` in `backend/src/service/servicing/repayment.py` (new): calls `installment_ladder.ladder_state(loan_id, as_of_date)` (owned by E9-S3) to derive the oldest unpaid Installment and cumulative due/paid; allocates FIFO across whole Installments and, within the oldest unpaid Installment, applies interest before principal per D-K, so `applied_principal + applied_interest = amount`; calls `RepaymentRepository.insert` (owned by E9-S2) to append the immutable `repayment_posting` row.
2. Define `recalculate_after_repayment(loan_id, as_of_date) -> DelinquencyBucket` in `backend/src/service/delinquency/recalculation.py` (new): re-derives the oldest unpaid Installment via `installment_ladder.ladder_state` (owned by E9-S3) and classifies it through `classify` in `backend/src/config/delinquency.py` (owned by E11-S1) — never re-deriving bucket boundaries locally.
3. Extend `post_repayment` in `backend/src/service/servicing/repayment.py` (new) to call `loan_projection.set_projections(loan_id, outstanding_principal, delinquency_bucket)` (owned by E9-S2) in the same transaction as the `repayment_posting` insert: `outstanding_principal` falls by exactly the applied principal portion, and `delinquency_bucket` is set to the value returned by `recalculation.recalculate_after_repayment`.
4. Modify `backend/src/api/servicing/routes.py` (owned by E9-S2) so `POST /loans/{loan_id}/repayments` calls `repayment.post_repayment` in place of the tracer's inline insert.
5. Add the repayment-posting integration test in `backend/tests/integration/test_repayment_posting.py` (new), covering AC1-AC4: outstanding principal falls by exactly the applied principal portion of the payment (AC1); a new immutable `repayment_posting` row is appended with no pre-existing row updated (AC2); a loan whose oldest unpaid installment is 35 days past due recalculates to `DPD-30` after posting (AC3); a posting that clears every overdue installment recalculates to `CURRENT` with no late fee or penal interest charged (AC4).
